text_block_list.name: Male Partner
text_block_list.text:
Um... For a long time, I've... well... 
Y-You... about you... um—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Was that man able to properly confess 
his feelings to the lady, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh! Unlike a drama, you can't just 
rewind it...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Aaah!! I can't stop thinking about it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Unable to find out how the romance ended, 
Durandal was left with a lingering 
frustration..."
